story: It's 8:17 on a sunny Friday morning in Sumter Oaks, and the air is already a comfortable 75 degrees. Gary is out in his driveway stringing lights and speaker wire across his golf cart, while Donna pencils his practice and court time into her club calendar along with tonight's dinner at Rosa's. Across the street, Hal keeps a watchful eye on Magnolia Loop through his binoculars, both on Gary's cart modifications and on Donna's flamingos, and Rosa checks her pantry list before getting the main dish marinating in her kitchen.
events: Gary (gary golf cart): Start mounting the light strings and speaker wiring on the cart
Donna (donna club calendar): Check the calendar and pencil in Gary's practice, court time, and tonight's dinner at Rosa's
Hal (hal binoculars): Scan Magnolia Loop for Gary's cart mods and count Donna's flamingos
Rosa (rosa kitchen): Check the pantry list and get the main dish marinating for tonight's dinner

gary.thought_process: Request is filed at Town Hall with the 10 PM cutoff noted, and I've already laid out the light strings and speaker wiring on the workbench. Holiday lighting is allowed from Thanksgiving on, so I'm fine to build now and just hold off on putting anything up outside until then. Nobody's around to talk to, so the useful thing is to get my hands on the cart itself and start fitting the lights and speaker. Keeps me busy and feeling useful.

parameters.content: Start mounting the light strings and speaker wiring on the cart

donna.thought_process: It's Friday morning, 8:17, and Gary's first practice is tomorrow at ten. Nobody's around, so I should get things done at home. My pickleball bag is already packed from yesterday, but the club calendar is where I keep everything straight: Gary's practice, Rosa's dinner at six tonight with my deviled eggs, and the ladder. A quick look at the calendar will confirm the schedule and let me pencil in court time (within the two-hour limit) for Gary's session before I head out.

parameters.content: Check the calendar and pencil in Gary's practice, court time, and tonight's dinner at Rosa's

hal.thought_process: Friday morning, quiet, nobody around. I reviewed my notes last tick, and Donna already pulled the extra flamingos around back, so that complaint is mostly settled. Gary's cart paperwork is the open item. I haven't seen it posted on the bulletin board yet. Before heading to dinner at six I should give the street a proper once-over. The binoculars on the porch are the right tool for a fair, by-the-book check of the cart and the flamingo count from here.

parameters.content: Scan Magnolia Loop for Gary's cart mods and count Donna's flamingos

rosa.thought_process: It's 8:17 AM Friday and the dinner is tonight at 6. I started prepping last tick, and nobody's around to talk to, so the best use of this hour is the kitchen. I should make sure the main dish is actually underway, since I may need to be at my shift schedule later and I don't want to be scrambling. Donna's deviled eggs already cover the mayo/mustard note, Hal's bringing a folding chair, and Gary's cart situation is sorted, so the table and food are what's left.

parameters.content: Check the pantry list and get the main dish marinating for tonight's dinner

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
